text:
Evie: Quick final runbook for Tue 11am PT webinar. Items: reg page A/B, Zoom primary + local backup, upload pipeline, HubSpot mapping, clips naming, and post-event cadence. Who owns what?

Joel: I can own recording + upload. Plan: enable cloud recording (speaker + gallery), also record locally on host laptop as backup. Add co-host @Ana so recording persists if host disconnects. Turn ON audio transcript and "record active speaker, gallery, shared screen separately". Keep 'Only authenticated users' OFF.

Ana: I'll own reg page and A/B test. Two variants: A = default copy w/ "See cost benchmarks" CTA, B = tighter CTA "Book a 15-min demo". Required fields: email, company, role. Hidden fields to capture: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term. Need HubSpot form GUID and webhook URL for realtime lead routing. Tagging event id: webinar_inference_launch_0412.

Sam: Editing + social clips here. Deliverables: 2x 30s product highlight (16:9), 2x 15s social hooks (9:16), one 90s highlight montage. Please provide raw MP4 + SRT and a raw transcript .txt. Naming convention request: `WI0412_raw.mp4`, `WI0412_transcript.txt`, `WI0412_clip01_30s_16x9.mp4`.

Joel: Upload flow after session: 1) Download cloud MP4 + audio + VTT from Zoom 2) Copy local backup if present 3) Upload to S3 bucket `s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-04-12-inference-launch/raw/` 4) Create a Google Drive editor folder and post link in thread. I'll set ACL to marketing-editors.

Joel: Manual commands for quick upload:
```
aws s3 cp "LocalZoomRecording.mp4" "s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-04-12-inference-launch/raw/WI0412_raw.mp4" --acl bucket-owner-full-control
aws s3 cp "LocalZoomAudio.m4a" "s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-04-12-inference-launch/raw/WI0412_audio.m4a"
aws s3 cp "transcript.vtt" "s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-04-12-inference-launch/raw/WI0412_transcript.vtt"
```

OpsBot: Reminder: make sure S3 lifecycle rule does not auto-delete raw for 90 days.

Ana: HubSpot mapping draft:
- hs_form_guid: 5f3a1b2c
- fields: [email, firstname, lastname, company, job_title, use_case, utm_source, utm_campaign, utm_term]
- lead_owner: assign_to_queue(marketing_webinars)
- contact_tag: webinar_inference_launch_0412
I will paste the webhook endpoint once Ops confirms the endpoint.

Sam: For edits: please include timecodes in the filename or a simple timestamps.txt. I will mark the 3 clip ranges and export masters at 1080p (16:9) and 1080x1920 (9:16). Caption source: prefer VTT from Zoom; I will convert to SRT.

Evie: Post-event cadence proposal: 45m after: replay email (short + link to private replay + scheduler CTA). 18h after: highlights + clips email + social push. 48h after: full edited recording + transcript + blog summary. 72h after: asset library finalized; SDRs get list of attendees marked MQL if job_title matches ICP.

Joel: I will add Ana and Evie as co-hosts and test recording settings now. Backup step: if cloud recording fails, host should stop/start local recording then upload.

Ana: Published both reg page variants to staging. Please test with test+variantA@redwood.com and test+variantB@redwood.com and confirm HubSpot fields populate including UTMs.

Evie: I'll run registration tests at 4pm PT and post results. Also please confirm calendar invite settings include alternate dial-in and show CTA links.

ZoomBot: Recording started by host Joel at 11:02 AM PT. Cloud recording enabled.

Joel: After the webinar I'll: (a) download cloud MP4 & VTT within 1h, (b) upload to S3, (c) create Drive folder and invite Sam & editors, (d) ping this thread with links and file names.

Sam: Copy for replay email suggestion: "Thanks for joining our demo of Redwood serving inference. Watch the replay and clips here. If youd like to chat about your workload, book a quick demo." Keep it punchy.

Evie: Owners recap: Reg pages & A/B testing = Ana; Zoom host + uploads = Joel; Clips & edits = Sam; Replay emails & cadence = Evie. Deadline: raw files uploaded and Drive link posted within 2 hours of end, clips & highlight drafts in 48 hours.

ZoomBot: Recording ended at 12:08 PM PT. Cloud recording available at https://zoom.us/rec/share/EXAMPLE_LINK_0412 (access restricted).
